info.title: Continuum Chat API
info.description: User-confirmed v1 contract for human one-to-one and room chat. The public HTTP paths are served by the Gateway; the standalone Chat service uses its /internal prefix. All operations derive the actor and organization from an IAM-validated session.

x-design-status: Implemented for the requested Chat v1 scope; this records the user-authorized implementation contract and does not claim separate external review approvals.

get.summary: Search active organization members: folded word-prefix names and literal indexed email prefixes; exact email matches rank first

200.description: Candidates with a point-in-time presence snapshot.

get.summary: List accessible conversations, optionally matching part of a room title or direct peer name (case and diacritic insensitive)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Literal substring; empty returns all accessible conversations. Filtering precedes cursor pagination.

200.description: A cursor page ordered by recent activity.

post.summary: Open the unique direct conversation for two organization members

200.description: The existing direct conversation or the newly created one.

201.description: The new room. Repeating the same payload with the same clientRoomId returns the same room.

200.description: Room renamed and update event published.
Active members added to the room.

parameters.name: aroundMessageId
parameters.description: Mutually exclusive with cursor. Returns the target and up to limit-1 surrounding messages, oldest first. nextCursor continues to older context; return to latest for newer history. Target must belong to this accessible conversation, otherwise 404.

200.description: Conversation messages, including inline replies, ordered oldest to newest within the returned page.

201.description: The stored message. Reusing clientMessageId for this sender and conversation returns the original message.

get.summary: Search a literal substring of non-deleted message content, ignoring case and diacritics, within an accessible conversation

200.description: Conversation-scoped literal substring results ordered by message cursor. Case and Vietnamese diacritics are ignored; deleted messages are excluded.

201.description: Creates a short-lived upload record. Images use AWS S3; documents use Cloudflare R2.

200.description: The bytes were streamed to the configured object store.

400.description: The uploaded byte count does not match the declared size.

200.description: The object metadata was checked against the pending upload record.

400.description: The object is missing or does not match the declared size or type.

200.description: A five-minute signed download URL, issued only to active conversation members.
The message is tombstoned and its content is erased.

post.summary: Create a one-use WebSocket ticket valid for at most 30 seconds

200.description: The ticket is bound to the IAM-validated actor and access-token session.

x-websocket.publicRoute: Same-origin HTTPS/WSS ingress route; browser clients use a one-use ticket in the ticket.<value> WebSocket subprotocol. The ticket is never placed in a URL.
x-websocket.delivery: MongoDB is the source of truth. Redis Pub/Sub only routes best-effort realtime events; reconnecting clients reload the cursor-paginated HTTP history. Message events go to active sessions of conversation members; typing goes only to sockets subscribed to that conversation. Presence changes go only to authorized direct-conversation watchers, while search returns a snapshot for the current candidate page.

NoStore.description: Chat data and ticket responses are not cacheable.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or inactive IAM session.

ValidationError.description: Invalid request, cursor, or out-of-scope participant.

ConversationUnavailable.description: Conversation is missing or the actor is not an active member.

IdempotencyConflict.description: An idempotency key was reused for a different request body.

RateLimited.description: The operation exceeded its actor-scoped rate limit.

DependencyUnavailable.description: IAM, Redis, or chat persistence is unavailable.

replyToMessageId.description: Optional message in this conversation to quote. The reply appears in the normal conversation timeline.
